claims.statement: For the ordinary tree T_5 consisting of path 0-1-2 and five three-leaf claws attached at 0, at p=10 one has alpha=17, x=8, both original leaf orbits are strictly favorable, the complete favorable set has 16 leaves, and the exact full aggregate is S=-84215.
claims.scope: One exact eligible instance of the registered T_m family at m=5 and p=10; no universal implication.
claims.reason: A graph-derived independent-set recurrence verifies the guards, both orbit selectors, marked counts and E=kU+C identity; the full sum is independently recomputed from every original leaf's support and closed-neighborhood deletions.

limitations: This exact finite row is not a census or a proof of any universal claim.
No exact deficient cut or feasible flow certificate for the enlarged mixed weighted Hall network was obtained.
Orbit quotienting preserves cuts only when the group acts on the complete network with all capacities and arc multiplicities; aggregate polynomial counts alone do not provide those data.
The asymmetric CB and T_m mixed-boundary cases remain unresolved.
